name: gfloge
description: Gfloge — self-hosted personal flight tracking with a logbook at its heart

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @gfloge/web && npx tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @gfloge/web && npm run lint --workspace @gfloge/api
